I found Hub/ServiceRouting.cs by searching for it, and the map switched to its Local Map view. Here's the link to that view:

http://127.0.0.1:8792/samples/estate/?%2BF8Mty7mwADEnHY3eMzsopgARYHSmEgJ4rfDi5r4Nlus4ddYgCpVHJQarYHRceAAK0z2dzIFQUAA2iAywAdED4dY12A1gASZFEAHogQ4Xg0EStwRt3ugdA2awAqGsAXRAE-gjLOpLI6HyuRA2ygIBb7c73cRffWqkHvng-DLoEhkA3rY7bJ3vbI-YPQ9XZ3Xo9TE4qQA

The whole view is saved in the link's `s=` part, so it should open just as I see it. The ServiceRouting.cs card is selected, showing its symbols (ServiceRouting, EndpointPrefix, EndpointNameFor and Internals), with a connection to PaymentHub.cs next to it.

The link points to 127.0.0.1, which means the computer opening it. It will only work on the same machine where this explorer is running on port 8792.
